data.name: Deep Sky
data.description: Deep Sky is a Montreal-based tech-agnostic carbon removal project developer that builds and operates DAC-to-storage infrastructure in Canada. Its flagship Deep Sky Alpha facility in Innisfail, Alberta began operations in August 2025, marking North America's first permanent underground sequestration of CO2 captured directly from the air, hosting multiple third-party DAC units including Skyrenu, Airhive, Mission Zero, DACMA, and GE Vernova.
